normal.name: rye serling
normal.text: whoa, it's so wild how i'm not complaining about Phantom Blade Zero not being a soulslike or seeming hardcore enough. i just find other games to scratch that itch, and i'm happy others have this. just a thought with how so much of the mainstream audience freaks out and complains about everything being a soulslike these days, when we had like four releases in the genre from big studios this year. #VideoGames #soulslike #SoulsGames #soulsgame #phantombladezero

normal.name: BaseLayoutsChief
normal.text: Quick Clash of Clans base tip: when you place your Air Sweepers, aim them so their push covers each other's blind spot instead of both facing outward. Balloons and Lava Hounds that slip past one get pushed straight into the other's range. How do you angle yours in war? #ClashOfClans #gaming

heated.name: Nicks World
heated.text: You know what I like about the sims? For me, its not all innocent and sweet. My sim had a little too much to drink, made a fool of herself, tried to steal some ice cream from an ice cream truck, splashed around in a public fountain, did some drunken dancing with some shady people and spent a night in a drunk tank in jail. Interesting times, for sure. #Gaming
